questions.question: What is GDG DevFest Indore 2026?
questions.answer: An annual developer conference by Google Developer Groups, with technical talks and hands-on learning.

questions.question: Who can attend DevFest?
questions.answer: Developers, researchers, students, tech leads, architects and founders. Choose the pass that matches your eligibility.

questions.question: Are campus workshops part of the event-day programme?
questions.answer: Campus workshops are separate events held before DevFest, with their own dates and registration details.

questions.question: Should I bring a laptop?
questions.answer: Bring your laptop and charger if you plan to join a hands-on lab. Setup instructions will be shared with the lab details.

questions.question: Which pass should I choose?
questions.answer: Students choose Cadet ({{studentPrice}}) with an ambassador code. Working professionals choose Commander ({{professionalPrice}}) and can book directly. Both include the same access.

questions.question: How do students get tickets?
questions.answer: Ask any listed ambassador for a code, then enter it in the Discount / Access Code field on KonfHub to book Cadet. Bring your **government photo ID** and **original student ID** to check-in.

questions.question: Are there any discounts?
questions.answer: An ambassador code gives 5% off any pass; enter it in the Discount / Access Code field on KonfHub. Commander also offers {{groupOffer}}, applied automatically. Discounts cannot combine, so use the bulk discount for 6–10 tickets.

questions.question: What should I bring for check-in?
questions.answer: Your QR ticket and an original government photo ID matching your registration.

questions.question: Does my ticket reserve a workshop seat?
questions.answer: Not automatically. Seats are limited, and a conference ticket does not reserve one.

questions.question: Can I cancel, refund or transfer my ticket?
